tools.name: retry_order

tools.description: Retry a failed payment on an existing order — re-attempts a declined charge or a failed refund using the order's card-on-file. coupon_code.description: Optional coupon code to apply to the initial charge. Case-insensitive. Failures (expired, exhausted, ineligible plan, currency mismatch, first-time-customer rule, etc.) surface as a structured error and the subscription is not created.

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED — prevents duplicate subscriptions on retries

tools.name: create_coupon
tools.title: Create coupon
tools.description: Create a coupon. kind="promo" mints a single shared code equal to the (normalized) name; kind="generated" mints unique codes either inline via the `codes` block or later via generate_coupon_codes. Exactly one of percentage or amount must be provided.

kind.description: Defaults to "generated". For "promo", name must match /^[A-Z0-9-]{4,50}$/ and becomes the redeemable code; max_redemptions_per_code and inline `codes` are rejected.

name.description: Display name. For kind="promo" the normalized (trim + uppercase) value also becomes the redeemable code, so it must be reusable as one (letters, digits, hyphens, 4-50 chars).

percentage.description: Percent off, 0 < x <= 100. Exactly one of percentage or amount must be provided.

amount.description: Flat amount off, in CENTS. Exactly one of percentage or amount must be provided. Requires currency; rejected for kind-agnostic percentage-off coupons.

currency.description: ISO-4217 alpha-3 (e.g. "USD"). Defaults to USD. Required-context for amount-off; rejected with a non-USD value when paired with percentage (percentage is currency-agnostic).

max_discount_amount.description: Per-redemption cap in CENTS. Percentage-off coupons only — rejected for amount-off (the fixed value already plays the role of a cap).

duration.description: Discount lifetime on a subscription: "once" = first charge only, "repeating" = first N cycles (set duration_in_cycles), "forever" = every cycle. Defaults to "once".

duration_in_cycles.description: Required when duration="repeating"; must be omitted otherwise.

minimum_amount.description: Minimum order subtotal in CENTS required for the coupon to apply.

first_time_customer_only.description: When true, only customers with zero prior paid orders may redeem.

max_redemptions.description: Total redemptions allowed across all codes minted under this coupon.

max_redemptions_per_code.description: Per-code redemption cap. Only meaningful for kind="generated"; rejected for kind="promo" (use max_redemptions to cap the shared code).

max_redemptions_per_customer.description: Per-customer redemption cap (across all codes of this coupon).

starts_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time. Coupon is inert before this moment.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time. Must be strictly after starts_at when both are provided.

product_scope.description: Product applicability. "specific" requires product_ids non-empty. At least one of product_scope/plan_scope must be non-"none".

plan_scope.description: Plan (subscription) applicability. "specific" requires plan_ids non-empty. At least one of product_scope/plan_scope must be non-"none".

product_ids.description: UUIDs (or prefixed IDs). Required non-empty when product_scope="specific".

plan_ids.description: UUIDs (or prefixed IDs). Required non-empty when plan_scope="specific".

codes.description: Optional inline batch mint at create time. kind="generated" only — rejected for kind="promo". When omitted, the coupon is created with no codes; mint later via generate_coupon_codes.

length.description: Total code length (prefix + random suffix). Must leave >=4 random chars after the prefix.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to prevent duplicate creation on retry.

currency.description: ISO-4217 alpha-3 (e.g. "USD"). Defaults to USD. Required-context for amount-off; rejected with a non-USD value when paired with percentage (percentage is currency-agnostic).

max_discount_amount.description: Per-redemption cap in CENTS. Percentage-off coupons only — rejected for amount-off (the fixed value already plays the role of a cap).

duration.description: Discount lifetime on a subscription: "once" = first charge only, "repeating" = first N cycles (set duration_in_cycles), "forever" = every cycle. Defaults to "once".

duration_in_cycles.description: Required when duration="repeating"; must be omitted otherwise.

minimum_amount.description: Minimum order subtotal in CENTS required for the coupon to apply.

first_time_customer_only.description: When true, only customers with zero prior paid orders may redeem.

max_redemptions.description: Total redemptions allowed across all codes minted under this coupon.

max_redemptions_per_code.description: Per-code redemption cap. Only meaningful for kind="generated"; rejected for kind="promo" (use max_redemptions to cap the shared code).

max_redemptions_per_customer.description: Per-customer redemption cap (across all codes of this coupon).

starts_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time. Coupon is inert before this moment.

product_scope.description: Product applicability. "specific" requires product_ids non-empty. At least one of product_scope/plan_scope must be non-"none".

tools.name: archive_coupon
tools.title: Archive coupon
tools.description: Soft-archive a coupon. Existing redemptions are preserved; the coupon stops accepting new redemptions and drops out of the default list. Naturally idempotent — archiving an already-archived coupon returns success.

tools.name: unarchive_coupon
tools.title: Unarchive coupon
tools.description: Remove the archive flag on a coupon. The coupon returns to the default list but stays paused (`active: false`) — archiving sets `active: false` and unarchive does not flip it back, so call update_coupon with `{ active: true }` to actually resume redemptions. Naturally idempotent.

tools.name: generate_coupon_codes
tools.title: Generate coupon codes
tools.description: Mint a batch of coupon codes under an existing coupon. Provide either `count` (server-generated random codes, optionally shaped by `prefix`/`length`) OR `codes` (caller-supplied literal strings) — never both. Rejected for kind="promo" (which has a single shared code minted at create time).

codes.description: Custom-mint path: caller-supplied codes. Each must match /^[A-Z0-9-]{8,50}$/i; trimmed + uppercased on save. prefix/length are rejected on this path.

prefix.description: Only valid on the `count` path. Trimmed + uppercased.

length.description: Only valid on the `count` path. Must leave >=4 random chars after the prefix.

expires_at.description: Per-batch expiry applied to every minted code. Independent of the coupon-level expires_at.

tools.title: Validate coupon
tools.description: Test whether a coupon code is currently redeemable in a given context (plan/product/customer/amount). Pure read — does NOT create a redemption. Redemption happens server-side when an order or subscription references the code. Returns { valid: true, ...terms } or { valid: false, reason }.

code.description: The redeemable code string. Trimmed + uppercased before lookup.

plan_id.description: Plan ID to test plan-scope eligibility against.

product_id.description: Product ID to test product-scope eligibility against.

customer_id.description: Customer ID for per-customer caps and first-time-customer-only checks.

amount.description: Order subtotal in CENTS. Used for minimum_amount eligibility.

currency.description: ISO-4217. Only meaningful when amount is provided.

tools.name: create_customer_and_subscribe
tools.title: Create customer and subscribe
tools.description: Onboarding composite: creates a new customer, attaches a card captured with EPD Elements, and creates a subscription — all in one operation. Requires a card_token (cct_...) from EPD Elements; the card is vaulted in EPD's secure vault (raw card data never reaches the API). Requires an idempotency_key. Creates a recurring billing relationship. If the subscription step fails, the just-created customer + payment method are automatically rolled back; if rollback itself fails, the response includes a partial_rollback_failed flag with the orphaned IDs.

card_token.description: Single-use card-capture token (cct_...) from the EPD Elements browser SDK. Your frontend captures the card with a publishable key and exchanges it for this token; expires 15 minutes after capture and can be used once.

billing_details.description: Cardholder billing details stored with the card. Some processors require a full billing address to vault; name/email/phone fall back to the customer record when omitted.

plan_id.description: Plan ID to subscribe to — use list_plans to find options

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED — prevents duplicate customer/subscription creation on retries

tools.name: process_order
tools.title: Process order
tools.description: Validates a customer then creates and processes a payment order in one step. Charges a card on the merchant's gateway. Requires an idempotency_key. On gateway failure the order row remains persisted with status="failed" so you can audit the attempt — there is no automatic rollback. Returns a success flag and any failure reason.

payment_method_id.description: UUID of the payment method to charge

metadata.description: Up to 50 key-value pairs (max 40-char keys, 500-char values)

tools.name: cancel_subscription_and_report
tools.title: Cancel subscription and report
tools.description: Cancels a subscription and returns a billing summary — cycles completed and total amount billed. Useful for understanding the revenue impact of a cancellation.

idempotency_key.description: Re-cancelling the same subscription is a no-op even without a key

tools.name: get_customer_financial_summary
tools.title: Get customer financial summary
tools.description: Returns a holistic financial overview for a customer: profile, payment methods, subscriptions, recent orders, recent transactions, and lifetime value.

include_transactions.description: Whether to fetch recent transactions (default true)

transaction_limit.description: Number of recent transactions to include (default 20)

tools.name: get_revenue_summary
tools.title: Get revenue summary
tools.description: Returns aggregate revenue totals (gross sales, refunds, net) for a date range. Paginates through up to 10,000 transactions per side (sales and refunds). If the range exceeds that, the response sets "truncated": true — narrow the date range to get a complete total. All amounts are in cents.

from.description: Inclusive lower bound — ISO 8601 datetime with timezone, e.g. "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"

to.description: Exclusive upper bound — ISO 8601 datetime with timezone, e.g. "2026-02-01T00:00:00Z"

tools.name: list_past_due_subscriptions
tools.title: List past-due subscriptions
tools.description: Lists subscriptions in past_due status with customer and plan info expanded. Use this for dunning workflows — the list of customers who need outreach due to failed payments.

tools.name: refund_transaction
tools.title: Refund transaction
tools.description: Refund a transaction by its ID. Looks up the transaction, resolves its linked order, then processes the refund. Amount is in cents; omit for a full refund. Requires an idempotency_key.

amount.description: Refund amount in cents. Omit for full refund.

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED — prevents duplicate refunds on retries

tools.name: setup_webhook_monitoring
tools.title: Setup webhook monitoring
tools.description: Creates a webhook endpoint pre-configured for a given event scope. A convenience tool for first-time integrators. The signing secret is returned in the response and will not be shown again.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint URL (must start with https://)

scope.description: "all" subscribes to every event; others scope to a resource domain

tools.name: create_customer_and_charge
tools.title: Create customer and charge
tools.description: Onboarding composite: creates a new customer, attaches a card captured with EPD Elements, and charges them — all in one operation. Requires a card_token (cct_...) from EPD Elements; the card is vaulted in EPD's secure vault (raw card data never reaches the API). Requires an idempotency_key. Charges a card. On failure the just-created customer + payment method are automatically rolled back; if the rollback itself fails the response includes a partial_rollback_failed flag with the orphaned customer_id.

card_token.description: Single-use card-capture token (cct_...) from the EPD Elements browser SDK. Your frontend captures the card with a publishable key and exchanges it for this token; expires 15 minutes after capture and can be used once.

billing_details.description: Cardholder billing details stored with the card. Some processors require a full billing address to vault; name/email/phone fall back to the customer record when omitted.

items.description: Line items to charge — price is taken from the product catalog

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED — prevents duplicate charges on retries

tools.name: refund_and_cancel
tools.title: Refund and cancel
tools.description: Cancel an active subscription and issue a full refund on the customer's most recent succeeded order. Subscription cancellation runs first to stop billing immediately; the refund follows. If cancellation fails, neither step is committed. If cancellation succeeds but refund fails, the response sets `refund_status: "failed"` with the original-order ID so the caller can retry the refund manually. Requires an idempotency_key.

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED — prevents duplicate refund or cancel operations on retries

tools.name: retry_failed_charge
tools.title: Retry failed charge
tools.description: Retrieve a failed transaction and re-attempt the charge against the same or a specified payment method. Reconstructs the original order from the failed transaction. Requires an idempotency_key.

payment_method_id.description: UUID of a different payment method to use. Omit to retry with the same payment method.

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED — prevents duplicate charges on retries
